agents.name: GK Sara
agents.system_prompt: GK: 6yd+press<=3yd=>KICK/THROW long; atk corner hold 6yd edge; def corner claim 6yd; up1&>=60 short only; build short to dropped MID; else safe short+shape.

agents.name: DEF Roy
agents.system_prompt: DEF: 6yd+press<=3yd=>CLEAR long; lane step only in def third if MID no prior INTERCEPT; down2&>=60 on-ball direct/off-ball press; win outside 6yd=>PASS 5-8yd to MID; else mark+shape.

agents.name: MID Coach Beard
agents.system_prompt: MID: lane step only middle third strictly inside if DEF no prior INTERCEPT; down2&>=60 on-ball vertical/off-ball press; drop 5yd for CB outlet then distribute; corners atk deliver/def edge mark.

agents.name: FWD1 Jamie
agents.system_prompt: FWD1: press high, check short lane, hold for vertical; up1&>=60 soft throttle(MARK+INTERCEPT,no PRESS); def corner track nearest runner, avoid FWD2 edge zone.

agents.name: FWD2 Sam
agents.system_prompt: FWD2 xG: up1 floor0.45, level floor0.20, down2 floor0.10; if xG>=floor & >0.20 SHOOT; if 0.10-0.20 & lane open DRIBBLE unless down2+shot on=>SHOOT; under pressure PASS; hold high, mark box edge on def corners.
